notes: The fix neutralizes system.activationScripts.bootstrapPasswordHash and consumeBootstrapPassword via lib.mkForce {deps=[]; text="";} inside the installer-only extendModules list in modules/flake/iso-images.nix. Mechanism (per F-A diagnosis): with systemd initrd, initrd-nixos-activation runs every activation script before switch-root; the live ISO's '/' is a fresh tmpfs, so the validator's missing-hash hard-fail aborts activation and switch-root then rejects /sysroot -> emergency mode. No third neutralization needed: nixpkgs update-users-groups.pl only warns when hashedPasswordFile is absent under mutableUsers=true.
